Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.keys

Class RotateSigningKeysUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.keys.RotateSigningKeysUseCase
@Service @Transactional public class RotateSigningKeysUseCase extends Object
Use case that keeps the signing keys rotating. One call, made at start-up and then on a schedule, does whatever is due: it creates the active and next keys when they are missing, promotes next to active and retires the old active key once the rotation interval has elapsed, always leaves a fresh next key behind, and deletes keys retired for longer than the effective retention (see SigningKeyRetention). A second call right after the first changes nothing, and the whole call runs under the repository's rotation lock, so several instances can call it safely. executeForced() is the administrator's path: it replaces the active key immediately, whatever its age.
